correctness.rationale: At each degree-two vertex, the equilibrium equation is XOR of its two neighbors, giving a period-three word from hub action and first-arm action. The three leaf residues impose respectively a=0, a=c, or c=0. The hub equation excludes singleton active arms when c=0 and forces exactly one residue-one arm with no residue-two arms when c=1. These two exhaustive cases yield the claimed polynomial, count and existence criterion. The standalone direct exhaustive checker passed on 704 spiders and 4,468,176 binary profiles.

value.rationale: This exact all-parameter equilibrium polynomial resolves a motivated family of instances of a globally NP-complete binary game. It classifies both existence and number of each producer count on a natural infinite branching-tree class, including exponentially many equilibria and a center-active exception; its significance is the natural family-level structural spectrum, not the cost of checking an instance.
